title: ArtifactSaveInput
description: Input of `gentry artifact save --input`: file or url, not both. An unknown field is an error. The source is not part of the input: Gentry determines it by who calls the command.

name.description: Name of the artifact: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.

file.description: File to keep a copy of.

url.description: Address of the artifact, with http:// or https://.
